hook: Hyderabad's AQI averaged *509* the night after Deepavali
hook_b: Hyderabad's AQI averaged *509* the night after Deepavali
tldr: Deepavali smoke kept Hyderabad's air at hazardous levels into Monday morning.

beats.what: The Hindu reports air quality worsened overnight, with PM2.5 at 392 µg/m³ at 9:30 pm and an average AQI of 509.
beats.why: Fireworks smoke settles when winds are weak. Hyderabad Mail reports IMD expects dry conditions from Nov 9 through the week.
beats.care: Check your area's AQI before outdoor runs or school drop-offs today.

cards.body: The Hindu: the air of Deepavali celebrations lingers in Hyderabad with AQI at hazardous levels. Hyderabad Mail: isolated rain on Nov 8, dry conditions forecast for the following week.
